An '''annex''' was a secret storage site of the [[Offworld Mining Corporation]] hidden inside the wall of the [[Enrichment Dome]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. The dome was used by the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]], a branch of the [[Jedi Service Corps/Legends|Jedi Service Corps]], to grow [[Plant/Legends|plants]] for their agricultural research. The annex was used by Offworld to store [[Mining/Legends|mining]] supplies such as [[Bomb/Legends|explosives]], [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. By keeping this annex located in an AgriCorps facility, Offworld was violating AgriCorps rules.<ref name="TDR" />

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]'' to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].</ref> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], a failed [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] who had been assigned to work with the AgriCorps on Bandomeer found the annex while exploring the dome. Shortly after the discovery, Kenobi reported its existence to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].<ref name="TDR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The annex was featured in the [[1999]] young adult novel ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]'', written by [[Jude Watson]]. ''The Dark Rival'' was the second book in the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] series.<ref name="TDR" />
